headline: Managing Your High Plains Beach Reservation
reservation: Advance reservations for all camping sites at Lake McConaughy SRA are mandatory via the Nebraska Game and Parks Commission website. Day-use permits must be purchased separately from overnight fees; the system often reaches capacity on summer weekends. Always check the official agency site for current water level impacts on beach driving and ramp access.

days.title: White Sands and Engineering Feats

stops.name: Martin Bay
stops.detail: Enjoy the expansive white sand beaches and clear water of Nebraska's largest reservoir.

stops.name: Kingsley Dam
stops.detail: Visit the Water Interpretive Center to learn about the massive earth-fill dam structure.

days.driving: Allow 20–30 minutes from town to the dam; conditions vary
days.note: Beach access points can fill early; arrival before mid-morning is recommended.

days.title: River Valleys and Birdwatching

stops.name: Lake Ogallala State Recreation Area
stops.detail: Explore the calmer waters below the dam, ideal for kayaking and spotting bald eagles.

stops.name: Eagle Viewing Center
stops.detail: Observe migratory raptors in a quiet setting near the North Platte River (seasonal).

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes between the upper and lower lake areas; conditions vary
days.note: The lower lake offers a more sheltered environment when winds pick up on the 'Big Mac'.

days.title: Oregon Trail History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from the South Shore

stops.name: Ash Hollow State Historical Park
stops.detail: View the preserved wagon ruts at Windlass Hill where pioneers descended into the valley.

stops.name: Front Street Museum
stops.detail: Step into a recreated 1870s cowtown in Ogallala to experience the Old West legacy.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes to Ash Hollow; conditions vary
days.note: Hiking trails at Ash Hollow involve some elevation; wear sturdy footwear for the rocky paths.

intel.title: Beach Access Capacity
intel.text: Parking at Arthur Bay and Martin Bay is limited and monitored during peak summer months. If primary lots are full, staff may redirect traffic to less crowded southern access points.

intel.title: Sandhill Coverage
intel.text: Cell service is intermittent in the low-lying basins around the lake and near Ash Hollow. Pre-download navigation tools for the drive from North Platte.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: Fuel and groceries are concentrated in Ogallala and Lewellen. There are no full-service stations directly on the park beaches; top off before leaving town.

intel.title: Wind and Weather
intel.text: Prairie winds can escalate quickly; monitor local forecasts if planning to be on the open water. Mornings generally offer the calmest conditions for small watercraft.

intel.title: Driving on Sand
intel.text: Beach driving is permitted in designated zones but is highly dependent on current water levels. Check official signage to avoid becoming stuck in soft prairie sand.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at North Platte Regional Airport; stop for groceries in Ogallala before the final 20-minute drive to the lake shoreline.
plan.vehicle: A high-clearance vehicle is recommended if you intend to utilize permitted beach driving areas; check rental contracts for off-pavement restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Windlass Hill provides a vast perspective of the North Platte valley at sunset, subject to seasonal weather patterns.
